q.zh: 你是做什么的？

a.zh: 我做 AI 产品功能，也给每个功能出题做评测：带出处的问答、审核和标注 Agent、经营分析 Agent、给创作者用的 Skill。一共 15 个公开项目。
a.en: I build AI product features and the tests that check them: question answering with sources, review and labelling agents, a business-review agent and skills for creators. There are 15 public projects.

q.zh: 你在找什么工作？

a.zh: 正在找 AI 产品、评测、运营方向的实习。随时可以到岗，每周天数不限，可以实习 3 个月。
a.en: An internship in AI product, evaluation or operations. I can start any time, work any number of days a week, and stay for 3 months.

q.zh: 你的背景？

a.zh: 莫纳什大学马来西亚校区（Monash University Malaysia）计算机科学本科在读，预计 2028 年毕业。
a.en: Computer science undergraduate at Monash University Malaysia, expected to graduate in 2028.

q.zh: 你最拿手的是什么？

a.zh: 出评测集和评分规则（Agent 评测台、模型裁判校准）；搭 Agent 和工作流（有据审核、有据标注流水线）；写 Skill、命令行和 MCP 工具（有据可查）；用 SQL 和 Pandas 做数据分析（有据经营分析）。
a.en: Building test sets and scoring rules (Agent Trace Eval, Judge Calibration); building agents and workflows (Grounded Review, Grounded Labelling Pipeline); writing skills, command-line and MCP tools (evidence-check); analysing data with SQL and Pandas (Grounded Business Review).

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 先看哪个项目？
q.en: Which project should I look at first?

a.zh: 看评测：Agent 评测台、模型裁判校准。看审核和标注：有据审核、标注 Agent 工具箱。看能直接装上用的工具：有据可查。
a.en: Evaluation: Agent Trace Eval and Judge Calibration. Review and labelling: Grounded Review and the Labelling Agent Kit. A tool you can install today: evidence-check.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 用过哪些工具？

a.zh: 评测：promptfoo、agentevals、Inspect AI。Agent 和工作流：Claude 接口和批量接口、Agent Skill、MCP、Lark 工作流、Dify。数据和检索：Python、SQL、Pandas、BM25、向量检索、OCR、LoRA 微调。
a.en: Evaluation: promptfoo, agentevals, Inspect AI. Agents and workflows: the Claude API and batch API, Agent Skills, MCP, Lark workflows, Dify. Data and retrieval: Python, SQL, Pandas, BM25, vector search, OCR, LoRA fine-tuning.

q.zh: 怎么联系你？

a.zh: 目前只放了 GitHub：llia0031-dotcom，每个项目的代码和报告都在上面。
a.en: For now, GitHub: llia0031-dotcom, where every project's code and report live.

q.zh: 一共多少个项目？代码在哪？
q.en: How many projects are there, and where is the code?

a.zh: 一共 15 个项目，代码和报告都公开在 GitHub，用 MIT 许可证。
a.en: 15 projects, with code and reports public on GitHub under the MIT licence.

q.zh: 哪些项目能直接打开试？
q.en: Which projects can I try in the browser?

a.zh: Cairn 的在线演示，有据审核和简历初筛的演示页，卖点体检的可点击原型，AI 生图创作指南和它的核对工具，标注 Agent 工具箱的结果查看页。TraceDesk Lite 和 Cairn 另有演示视频。
a.en: Cairn's live demo, the Grounded Review and resume-screening demo pages, Sellpoint Check's clickable prototype, the Text on Product guide and its checker, and the Labelling Agent Kit's results viewer. TraceDesk Lite and Cairn also have demo videos.

q.zh: 这些项目是一个人做的吗？
q.en: Did you build these on your own?

a.zh: Cairn 和 TraceDesk Lite 是黑客松上两人组队做的，其余 13 个是我一个人做的。
a.en: Cairn and TraceDesk Lite were built by a team of two at hackathons; the other 13 I built on my own.

q.zh: 用的什么模型？

a.zh: 默认用 claude-haiku-5-5，大批评测走批量接口，价格减半；对照时才加别的模型，例如本机跑的 Qwen 小模型、做第二裁判的 claude-sonnet-5-5。
a.en: claude-haiku-5-5 by default, with large evaluations through the batch API at half price; other models only for comparison, such as small Qwen models run locally or claude-sonnet-5-5 as a second judge.

q.zh: 评测是怎么做的？

a.zh: 先把题目和标准答案写好、冻结，再跑；每改一版在同一套题上重测，按事先写好的规则决定采不采用。改版记录一共 73 条，没采用的也留着。
a.en: Test items and answers are written and frozen before the run; every version is re-run on the same items and adopted or not by a rule written beforehand. There are 73 logged changes, dropped versions included.

q.zh: 做得最好的结果是什么？

a.zh: 标注 Agent：广告的微平均 F1 从 0.768 升到 0.971。模型裁判：和定好的答案一致 702/711。有据可查：编造数字的回答从 4/32 降到 0/32。
a.en: Labelling agent: ad micro F1 from 0.768 to 0.971. Model judge: agreement with fixed answers 702/711. evidence-check: answers with an invented number from 4/32 to 0/32.

label.zh: 评测卡：标注 Agent 工具箱

q.zh: 项目有英文版吗？
q.en: Are the projects available in English?

a.zh: 有。作品集的项目页和评测卡都有中英文两版；每个代码仓库都有英文说明，评测报告也是英文写的。
a.en: Yes. Every project page and evaluation card here comes in Chinese and English; every repository has an English README, and the evaluation reports are in English.

q.zh: 这些项目对应哪些业务场景？
q.en: Which business scenarios do the projects cover?

a.zh: 广告审核、内容标注、电商卖点和商品图、经营分析、创作工具、实时语音、招聘初筛，以及按公开资料回答问题。
a.en: Ad review, content labelling, product claims and product images, business review, creator tools, real-time voice, resume screening, and answering from public documents.

q.zh: 有广告审核方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 有据审核（广告审核说清违反哪一条、是哪几个字）；审核模型实验（审视频广告，模型要看什么、小模型够不够）；有据标注流水线（把广告审核做成能灰度、能回滚的工作流）。
a.en: Grounded Review (Ad review that names the rule and the exact words); Policy Model Lab (What a model must see to review a video ad); Grounded Labelling Pipeline (Ad review as a workflow with canary release and rollback).

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 有内容标注方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 标注 Agent 工具箱（标注 Agent 怎么调准，错在哪、为什么错）；有据标注流水线（把广告审核做成能灰度、能回滚的工作流）。
a.en: Labelling Agent Kit (Tuning a labelling agent, and why it fails); Grounded Labelling Pipeline (Ad review as a workflow with canary release and rollback).

q.zh: 有电商方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 卖点体检（从买家评价里找原话，证实商品页的卖点）；AI 生图创作指南（电商主图上的中文卖点，怎么写字最稳）。
a.en: Sellpoint Check (Checks listing claims against buyer reviews); Text on Product (How to keep Chinese copy right on AI product images).

label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

q.zh: 有经营分析方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 有据经营分析（经营周报：找异动原因，每个数字都对回查询结果）。
a.en: Grounded Business Review (Weekly review: find the cause, trace every number).

q.zh: 有创作工具方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 创作者 Skill 合集（给短视频创作者的三个 Skill，交出去前先核对）；AI 生图创作指南（电商主图上的中文卖点，怎么写字最稳）。
a.en: Creator skills (Three creator skills that check before they hand back); Text on Product (How to keep Chinese copy right on AI product images).

label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

a.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测（语音助手被打断、听到“嗯”时，还能办对事吗）。
a.en: Real-time voice agent evaluation (Can a voice agent stay right when interrupted).

q.zh: 有招聘方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 有据可查的简历初筛（初筛简历时，每个“符合”都附简历原文）。
a.en: Evidence-backed resume screening (Resume screening where every verdict quotes the resume).

q.zh: 有 Agent 评测方向的项目吗？

a.zh: Agent 评测台（会调工具的 Agent，每一步做对了吗）；实时语音 Agent 体验评测（语音助手被打断、听到“嗯”时，还能办对事吗）。
a.en: Agent Trace Eval (Did a tool-using agent get each step right); Real-time voice agent evaluation (Can a voice agent stay right when interrupted).

q.zh: 有模型评测方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 模型裁判校准（模型裁判能信到什么程度，哪些该交给人）；审核模型实验（审视频广告，模型要看什么、小模型够不够）；标注 Agent 工具箱（标注 Agent 怎么调准，错在哪、为什么错）。
a.en: Judge Calibration (How far a model judge can be trusted); Policy Model Lab (What a model must see to review a video ad); Labelling Agent Kit (Tuning a labelling agent, and why it fails).

q.zh: 有带出处的问答方向的项目吗？
q.en: Anything on question answering with sources?

a.zh: Cairn（按机构公开的规定回答问题，每句都附原文）；TraceDesk Lite（常见问题助手只按资料回答，截止时间都有出处）；有据可查 evidence-check（让 AI 的每句事实都附原文，再用脚本核对）。
a.en: Cairn (Answers from published rules, every sentence quoted); TraceDesk Lite (An FAQ assistant that answers only from its documents); evidence-check (Every fact an AI writes gets a quote a script checks).

q.zh: 有据可查 evidence-check 是什么？

a.zh: 让 AI 的每句事实都附原文，再用脚本核对。装上这个 Skill 后，AI 按资料回答时，编了数字的回答从 4/32 降到 0/32。
a.en: Every fact an AI writes gets a quote a script checks. With the skill, answers that made up a number fell from 4/32 to 0/32.

q.zh: Cairn 是什么？

a.zh: 按机构公开的规定回答问题，每句都附原文。正确页面排进前五条结果的：自己写的题 44/45，学生的真实提问 14/15。
a.en: Answers from published rules, every sentence quoted. The right page made the top five results for 44/45 written questions and 14/15 real student questions.

q.zh: TraceDesk Lite 是什么？

a.zh: 常见问题助手只按资料回答，截止时间都有出处。每个截止时间都附原文出处的回答有 20/20，普通写法只有 17/20。
a.en: An FAQ assistant that answers only from its documents. Answers whose every deadline came with its source: 20/20, against 17/20 with a plain prompt.

q.zh: 有据可查的简历初筛是什么？

a.zh: 初筛简历时，每个“符合”都附简历原文。附上简历原文后，判断几乎不出错（2735/2736），只换名字也不改变去留（0/240）。
a.en: Resume screening where every verdict quotes the resume. With resume quotes, verdicts were right 2735/2736 times; swapping names changed 0/240 decisions.

q.zh: 卖点体检是什么？

a.zh: 从买家评价里找原话，证实商品页的卖点。用买家评价核对卖点：答案已知的卖点判对 60/60，花费只有逐条读评价的 17%。
a.en: Checks listing claims against buyer reviews. Claims checked against reviews: 60/60 right on known answers, at 17% of the cost of reading reviews one by one.

q.zh: 有据审核是什么？

zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

a.zh: 广告审核说清违反哪一条、是哪几个字。对照英国监管机构的真实裁决，51/60 次判断一致，并指出违反哪条规定、哪几个字。
a.en: Ad review that names the rule and the exact words. Matched the UK regulator's real rulings in 51/60 decisions, naming the rule and the exact words.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

zh: AI 生图创作指南：电商主图上的中文字
en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

a.zh: 电商主图上的中文卖点，怎么写字最稳。Seedream 4.5 生成的主图，中文字全写对的 16/16；视频里只有 1/4。

label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

q.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测是什么？
q.en: What is Real-time voice agent evaluation?

zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

a.zh: 语音助手被打断、听到“嗯”时，还能办对事吗？背景有人说话时，助手从等 20.4 秒才开口，缩短到 4.56 秒。
a.en: Can a voice agent stay right when interrupted? With someone talking in the background, the assistant's wait before replying fell from 20.4 s to 4.56 s.

label.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

q.zh: 有据标注流水线是什么？

a.zh: 把广告审核做成能灰度、能回滚的工作流。让模型说“拿不准”后，判错又自动生效的从 17/332 降到 9/332。
a.en: Ad review as a workflow with canary release and rollback. Letting the model say it is unsure cut wrong decisions that went live from 17/332 to 9/332.

q.zh: 有据经营分析是什么？

a.zh: 经营周报：找异动原因，每个数字都对回查询结果。按题配对，Agent 比一次提示词多对 6 题、少对 0 题（p = 0.031）。
a.en: Weekly review: find the cause, trace every number. Case by case, the agent beat the one prompt 6 to 0 (exact p = 0.031).

q.zh: 创作者 Skill 合集是什么？

a.zh: 给短视频创作者的三个 Skill，交出去前先核对。装上 Skill 后，改好的字幕文件 20/20 完全正确，不装只有 2/20。
a.en: Three creator skills that check before they hand back. With the skill, corrected subtitle files were fully right 20/20; without it, 2/20.

q.zh: 审核模型实验是什么？

a.zh: 审视频广告，模型要看什么、小模型够不够。看 16 帧时违规全抓到（64/64），只给文案只抓到 25/64。
a.en: What a model must see to review a video ad. With 16 frames every violation was caught (64/64); with the caption only, 25/64.

q.zh: 模型裁判校准是什么？

a.zh: 模型裁判能信到什么程度，哪些该交给人。和定好的答案一致 702/711；要靠外部证据的监管结论只对 6/11。
a.en: How far a model judge can be trusted. Agreed with fixed answers on 702/711; only 6/11 on regulator decisions that turn on outside evidence.

q.zh: 标注 Agent 工具箱是什么？

a.zh: 标注 Agent 怎么调准，错在哪、为什么错。测试集 A 微平均 F1：广告 0.768 → 0.971，点评 0.715 → 0.824。
a.en: Tuning a labelling agent, and why it fails. Test A micro F1: ads 0.768 → 0.971, reviews 0.715 → 0.824.

q.zh: Agent 评测台是什么？

a.zh: 会调工具的 Agent，每一步做对了吗？关卡只拦下 1/17 的失败；不装 Skill，成功 21/24 → 8/24。
a.en: Did a tool-using agent get each step right? The release gates caught 1/17 of failures; without skills, creator success 21/24 → 8/24.

q.zh: 怎么决定一个改动采用不采用？
q.en: How do you decide whether to adopt a change?

a.zh: 每次只改一处，跑之前写下预测和采用规则，在同一套冻结的题上和上一版并排比；区间整个在零以上才算提升。例如标注 Agent 的第二版：点评上 +0.018 [+0.005, +0.031]，采用；广告上 +0.021 [+0.000, +0.048]，区间碰到零，不采用。
a.en: One change at a time, with predictions and an adoption rule written before the run, compared with the previous version on the same frozen items; a gain counts only when the whole interval is above zero. For example, the labelling agent's second version: on reviews +0.018 [+0.005, +0.031], adopted; on ads +0.021 [+0.000, +0.048], the interval reaches zero, not adopted.

label.zh: 标注 Agent 工具箱的迭代

q.zh: 怎么保证报告里的数字是真的？
q.en: How do you make sure the numbers are real?

a.zh: 评测卡上的 387 个数字全部由脚本从项目的结果文件算出，不手抄。作品集里的每个数字再用有据可查对回评测卡；跑完发现题目或答案有错，就公开更正、重跑，原来的数字并排保留。
a.en: All 387 numbers on the evaluation cards are computed by script from the projects' result files, never copied by hand. Every number in this portfolio is checked against the cards with evidence-check; a mistake in an item or answer found after a run is corrected in public and run again, with the old numbers kept alongside.

q.zh: 题目和标准答案从哪来？有没有人工标注？
q.en: Where do the test items and answers come from? Any human labels?

a.zh: 多数题目的答案在出题时就定好；另外用到监管机构和法院对真实广告的结论、公开数据集自带的标注和专家评分（例如 ASAP、SummEval），以及 Cairn 里学生用自己的话提的真实问题（经同意公开）。模型裁判校准、标注 Agent 工具箱和 Agent 评测台都没有另做人工评分。
a.en: Most items have answers fixed when they were written; also used are regulator and court decisions on real ads, the labels and expert ratings that ship with public datasets (such as ASAP and SummEval), and real questions students asked in their own words in Cairn, published with consent. Judge Calibration, the Labelling Agent Kit and Agent Trace Eval collected no human ratings of their own.

q.zh: 花了多少钱？

a.zh: 整个项目的花费，例如 Agent 评测台 1.48 美元，模型裁判校准 2.63 美元，标注 Agent 工具箱 3.6325 美元。
a.en: Whole-project spend, for example: Agent Trace Eval US$1.48, Judge Calibration US$2.63, Labelling Agent Kit US$3.6325.

label.zh: 评测卡：标注 Agent 工具箱

q.zh: 和现成的工具比有什么不同？
q.en: How is this different from existing tools?

a.zh: 开工前都先查过现成的，能用就直接用，例如 promptfoo、agentevals、Inspect AI；补的是它们没管的那一块。例如有据可查只核对数字和原文在不在给定的材料里，不像 RefChecker 那样判断一句话本身对不对。
a.en: Existing tools were checked first and used where they fit, such as promptfoo, agentevals and Inspect AI; what is added is the part they leave out. evidence-check, for instance, only checks whether numbers and quotes are in the given material, rather than judging whether a sentence is true the way RefChecker does.

q.zh: 有没有没做成的？

a.zh: 有，都照实写在评测卡里。Agent 评测台事先预测上线前的关卡能拦下大多数失败，结果 17 次失败只拦下 1 次。经营分析的修复把门店定位改对了，回归重测却查出另一道题变差。
a.en: Yes, and the cards say so. Agent Trace Eval predicted the release gates would catch most failures; of 17 failures they caught 1. The business-review fix located store closures correctly, yet the regression run found another task getting worse.

q.zh: 放到真实业务里还差什么？
q.en: What would it take to use this in production?

a.zh: 题目多是合成或虚构的，上线前要用业务里已有结论的样本另建测试集；每题跑的次数少、区间偏宽。要靠外部证据才能定的判断应该留给人：模型裁判在这类监管结论上只对了 6/11。
a.en: Most items are synthetic or fictional, so real use needs a test set from business cases with settled outcomes; few runs per item leave wide intervals. Decisions that turn on outside evidence should stay with people: the model judge got only 6/11 of such regulator decisions right.

q.zh: 遇到过最难的问题是什么？

a.zh: 简历初筛里，核对引文的那一步把对的“符合”也当成错的丢掉了：70/424。这一步前后改了两版。改完后降到 0/422，再用陷阱题和植入的错误检验。
a.en: In resume screening, the quote-checking step threw away correct "met" verdicts as well: 70/424. That step was rewired twice. It then came down to 0/422, checked with traps and planted errors.

fallback.zh: 这个我没写在作品集里。
